paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
coupling_convention: d_n in e*cm (oscillating neutron EDM amplitude)
notes: CASPEr-electric solid-state NMR search, 162-166 neV. Main limit: |g_d|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2, corresponding to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude <1.0e-21 e*cm. Paper also reports gradient coupling g_aNN<2.8e-1 GeV^-1 (would be AxionNeutron). Reported as flat upper bound over the ~162-166 neV mass band. Mass range derived from 39.1-40.2 MHz Compton frequency (m=4.136e-15*f); using stated 162-166 neV. Data points given as band endpoints from text since no table extracted.
